Alice M: heads up — main CI is red on self-hosted runners, decrypt step 403 KMS accessDenied. Started ~10:01Z.
Alice M: log snippet:
```
[decrypt] ERROR: KMS: accessDenied: "projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/ci/cryptoKeys/secrets-key: Permission 'cloudkms.cryptoKeys.decrypt' denied."
job: e2e-tests / self-hosted-03
```
Alice M: I think this began after yesterday's IAM cleanup. Can someone confirm runner SA perms? @Carla R @Ben K
Ben K: on it. which runner id + project? also could be OIDC audience mismatch if tokens rotated.
Alice M: self-hosted-03, project redwood-ci-prod. SA = ci-runner@redwood-ops. We rotated keys last week but that shouldn't break OIDC.
Carla R: checking KMS audit — seeing denies at 2026-02-14T10:02Z. It looks like the role roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter was removed from ci-runner@redwood-ops during the least-priv patch. I'm re-adding now. ETA ~2m.
Dave (oncall): note that OIDC tokens minted before the binding is restored won't get new perms. We'll need the runner to fetch a new token or restart it. Can someone trigger a rerun once binding is back? @deploy-bot please rerun #1762 e2e-tests.
deploy-bot: @Dave requested rerun for workflow e2e-tests (#1762) on main — queued on self-hosted-03.
Ben K: also recommend canceling the current run and doing a full rerun (no cache) so token refresh is forced. Use `gh run rerun 1762 --repo redwood/inference`.
Alice M: canceling and requeueing now. thanks @Carla R
Carla R: policy change applied. Re-added role to ci-runner@redwood-ops. Reminder: OIDC token TTL is 1h, so the runner needs to mint a new token. I'm SSHing to self-hosted-03 to restart the runner service.
Alice M: I can restart if you want me to — say the word.
infra-bot: action: policy-change detected in project redwood-ci-prod: removed role cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter from ci-runner@redwood-ops at 2026-02-14T09:59Z (actor: carla.r)
Carla R: restarted runner and forced token refresh. Please check rerun.
deploy-bot: workflow #1762 started on self-hosted-03 (run id 48732).
Ben K: watching logs. :eyes:
deploy-bot: step decrypt-secrets FAILED again — 403 KMS accessDenied at 10:08Z.
Alice M: still failing, same error. @Carla R any other denies in the audit?
Carla R: hmm — there's an older SA lying around. Instance env had `CI_SERVICE_ACCOUNT=ci-runner@redwood-ops-sa` (legacy). Runner process was using the old SA creds. Switching env to ci-runner@redwood-ops and restarting now. Sorry missed that.
Alice M: nice catch.
Dave (oncall): we'll add a healthcheck to detect KMS decrypt denies and auto-restart the runner token in future. For now, can we fallback to hosted runners to unblock?
Ben K: I can flip the workflow to `runs-on: ubuntu-latest` to unblock quickly, or rerun targeted job on hosted. Might be faster.
Carla R: env fixed and restarted. New run queued.
deploy-bot: workflow #1762 started on hosted runner (ubuntu-latest) (run id 48733).
Ben K: decrypt step PASSED on hosted — tests running.
Alice M: thanks all. Follow-ups: patch to remove old SA env from bootstrap, add bootstrap check for SA name + KMS perms, update runbook with this incident.
Carla R: filing infra ticket INFRA-482 with details + remediation steps.
Alice M: great. If anything flakey later ping this thread. :heart:
